chat.initialMessage:
Hello! I'm your AI planning assistant. Tell me what extra requirements or preferences you have for the roster, and I'll include them when solving.

For example:
- *"Jan Bakker cannot work night shifts"*
- *"At least 3 employees per shift on Saturday"*
- *"Try not to schedule Marie and Thomas together"*
chat.constraintConfirm: ✅ Understood, I'll include this as an extra constraint when solving.
chat.postSolveInitial:
The roster has been solved! 🎉

I can help you with:
- **Shift swaps** — when an employee wants time off
- **Finding replacements** — for sick leave or unexpected absences
- **Impact analysis** — what happens if you make a change?

Ask your question and I'll provide concrete alternatives based on the current roster, contract hours, and WTA rules.
chat.shiftSwapPrompt: Franz-Xaver asked if he can be off on Wednesday. How can I best cover his shift?
chat.findAlternativePrompt: Who can take over Marie's Thursday night shift if she's sick?

landing.heroDesc: Planbition X transforms workforce scheduling from hours of manual puzzle‑work into AI‑powered, WTA‑compliant rosters — generated in seconds.
landing.featuresDesc: From automated compliance to real‑time disruption handling, Planbition X covers the full planning lifecycle.
landing.feat1Desc: Generate optimal rosters in seconds using advanced solver technology that balances compliance, preferences, and efficiency.
landing.feat2Desc: Automatic enforcement of working time regulations, rest periods, and legal requirements — zero manual checking.
landing.feat3Desc: What used to take hours of manual planning now happens in under 16 seconds with enterprise-grade accuracy.
landing.feat4Desc: AI-assisted disruption handling for sick leave, shift swaps, and last-minute changes with concrete alternatives.
landing.feat5Desc: Occupancy heatmaps, fill rate trends, labor cost estimates, and qualification distribution — all at a glance.
landing.feat6Desc: Available in 8 languages including Dutch, German, French, English, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, and Polish.
landing.microDesc: Planbition X is built as an independent microservice with a clean REST API. Workforce management vendors, ERP systems, and custom platforms can integrate our AI‑powered solver directly — no lock‑in, no monolith.
landing.microApiDesc: Send a JSON payload with employees, shifts, and constraints. Receive an optimized roster back. That's it.
landing.microWhiteLabelDesc: Embed the solver in your own product under your brand. We handle the optimization, you own the experience.
landing.microMultiTenantDesc: Scalable infrastructure with isolated tenant data. Each customer gets their own solver instance with guaranteed SLAs.
landing.microUsedBy: Already used by WFM providers, logistics platforms, and healthcare systems across Europe.
landing.pricingDesc: Drag the slider to see what Planbition X costs for your team.
landing.step1Title: Describe your preferences in plain language
landing.step1Desc: Simply tell the AI what you need — "Jan cannot work nights next week", "At least 3 people on Saturday" or "Marie prefers early shifts". No forms, no checkboxes. Just type what you want and the solver takes it into account.
landing.step2Title: AI Solver creates the optimal roster
landing.step2Desc: The solver weighs all preferences, qualifications, contract hours, and legal rules to generate the best possible roster — compliant and optimized in seconds.
landing.step3Desc: Someone calls in sick? Need a shift swap? Just tell the AI. It instantly finds the best alternatives and can even automatically reach out to available employees to arrange coverage.

home.heroDesc: Planbition is an extremely flexible system that can support virtually any scheduling process. From onboarding to time registration — the right people in the right place at the right time.
home.xDesc: The next generation of roster planning. With AI optimization, Planbition X generates WTA-compliant rosters in under a minute — including automatic disruption handling, shift swaps, and smart alternatives.
home.xPoint1: AI optimizer solves rosters in seconds
home.xCardSub: AI-driven roster planning — the future of workforce scheduling
home.featuresDesc: Planbition is an extremely flexible system that supports virtually any scheduling process — from onboarding to time registration.
home.feat1Desc: The operational planning module is the heart of the application. Overview and insight for efficient scheduling.
home.feat2Desc: Always up-to-date insight into your workforce portfolio — contracts, qualifications, and files accessible anywhere.
home.feat3Desc: Manage all your clients centrally with SLAs and KPIs per client for detailed management overview.
home.feat4Desc: Employees manage their own rosters, availability, leave requests, and can sign up for open shifts.
home.feat5Desc: Distribute demand across multiple suppliers with central oversight of the full schedule and KPIs.
home.feat6Desc: Complete reporting engine with lists, pivot tables, and Power BI integration for analysis at every level.
home.feat7Desc: Hardware terminals, geofencing, or manual entry — register time based on the schedule with automatic rounding rules.
home.feat8Desc: Open software with 18 standard APIs for import and export. Custom interfaces are also possible.
home.benefitsDesc: Available on all devices with unlimited free users. Planbition is highly configurable without expensive customizations.
home.benefitPayAsYouUse: Pay as you use — all modules included
home.benefitSaveTime: Save up to 85% of your planning time
home.benefitAudit: Audit trail and KPIs always at hand
